Before that, someone has to settle which limit is being asked for: the request you sent says **$300,000**, but the system of record (credit_requests.csv) and Sarah's 2026-09-23 email to Priya both say **$400,000**. Following the procedure, I decided on the $400,000 figure and made the difference a blocking condition. Either figure gives the same result.

**1. The request.** CR-9201, ERP customer C-1001. The current limit is $250,000, which matches erp_credit.csv. Requested 2026-09-23 by Sarah Chen (Enterprise Account Executive), status Pending Approval. It rests on Acme's own standing. Sarah's email mentions Acme Group's parent guarantee only in case "they need more headroom later", so the request doesn't depend on it.

**2. The customer.** Acme Mfg. Holdings (ERP C-1001) and Acme Manufacturing (CRM-2048) are the same company: same DUNS number (04-812-7730) and same address. It is not Acme Industrial Supply Co. (C-1044 / CRM-2091), a separate Standard account in Akron.

**3. The policy.** Northstar Credit Policy 2026, in effect 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31.

**4. Payment history.** No invoice due in the 12 months before the request was paid more than 30 days late or was unpaid more than 30 days past due:
- INV-60412 was due 2025-11-28 and paid 2025-11-24, early.
- INV-62011 was due 2026-07-25 and paid 2026-07-22, early.
- INV-62305 ($720,000) is due 2026-10-02, after the request date, so it doesn't count yet.
